_comment: Manual 2026 corrections for the draft board. The model labels players with their 2025 team, can't see offseason moves/cuts/suspensions, and blends against a cached crowd ADP that lags breaking news. Sources: nfl.com/sitemap/html/rosters/2026 (scraped 2026-08-31, ~90-man, pre-final-cuts) cross-checked vs nflverse roster_2026, CBS cut tracker, and the user's Sleeper draft-room data. Edit up to draft day. Names must match models/output/<league>_projections.csv 'name'; matching is punctuation/suffix-insensitive. Team abbreviations follow the board's convention (LA, LV, WAS, JAX).

out.Tyreek Hill: unsigned free agent, out of the league (Nov 2025 knee injury)

_notes.Josh Jacobs: On the commissioner's exempt list pending an NFL investigation — still drafted, but Sleeper ADP slid from ~top-25 to 146. The model can't see that; adp override feeds the real market signal into the blend. Draftable, not a drop.
